items.name: tokens
items.title: CYBR//UI tokens
items.description: Opt-in colour, border, shadow, focus and motion tokens. Add @import "../styles/cybr-tokens.css"; after @import "tailwindcss"; in app/globals.css. Fonts fall back to Impact / ui-monospace unless --font-archivo-black and --font-jetbrains-mono are defined.

items.name: hard-offset-button
items.title: Hard-Offset Button
items.description: Signal-filled button with a solid offset shadow that steps in on hover and presses flush on click. Requires @cybr/tokens.
